papers.title: Breed screening for myxomatous mitral valve disease in dogs.
papers.authors: Olsen LH, Swift S, Häggström J
papers.abstract: Myxomatous mitral valve disease contributes to cardiac morbidity and mortality in dogs worldwide. It is the most common heart disease in dogs. papers.abstract: Left-sided congestive heart failure (CHF) secondary to myxomatous mitral valve disease carries high morbidity and mortality in dogs.
